name: ff_fuel
description: Flex-fuel MVP: receive the Pico ethanol frame on RX slot 15 (id 0x0EC), run the OK/HOLD/FAULT machine with a filtered and slew-limited ethanol estimate from a 10 ms raster, and scale the relative fuel mass rk (0x803038) by F(E) in the engine-synchronous segment task. F = 1024 at E0 is bit-identical to stock.  D2 adds the diagnostics half: four measuring-variable handlers on the spare TKMWL ids 2196-2199, published as measuring block group 111, and the E% store in EEP_CONF block 8 through nvm_block_request.  E1 adds the ignition blend: a 10 ms producer computes dzw_e = f_zw(E) * ff_dzw_map(nmot, rl) as an s8 count of 0.75 degCA, and a ten-instruction stub in place of the `add r3,r3,r10` at 0x41D40C inside zwgru_build adds it to the base ignition angle before the knock retard and every stock clamp. It ships disabled (ff_zw_enable = 0) with an all-zero ff_dzw_map, and is published as VCDS measuring block 108 on TKMWL ids 2192-2195.  E2 adds the start enrichment: the same 10 ms producer computes fst_q10 = f_st(e_filt, tmst) in Q10 and zwst_add as an s8 count of 0.75 degCA, and three stubs consume them at the instruction that publishes each stock cell - two in the %ESSTT twins (0x41A680 and 0x41A808, ksta_adapted 0x80302C, the cranking lever) and one in zwstt_build (0x431384, zwstt 0x802096, the start angle). Both ship disabled (ff_st_enable = ff_zwst_enable = 0) with an all-1024 ff_fst_map and an all-zero ff_fzwst_curve, and they are published as VCDS measuring block 69 on TKMWL ids 2188-2191.  E5 adds the rail-pressure setpoint adder and the injection-window diagnostics: the same 10 ms producer computes prail_add = ff_prail_curve(e_filt) in the ECU's own 0.005 bar, and a twelve-instruction stub in place of the `sth r30,0x3200(r13)` at 0x45845C inside hdrpsol_main adds it to prsoll_raw 0x8031F0 - after the KFPRSOL* map bank and BEFORE the PRSOLMN floor, the KLPRMAX 110.0 bar ceiling and the pump-volume rate limiter, all three of which still bind because the clamp re-reads the cell from RAM at 0x458480. It ships disabled (ff_prail_enable = 0) with an all-zero ff_prail_curve. The same producer accumulates three diagnostics that run whether or not the adder does - the worst injection-window margin, the worst prist and the number of MSV-saturated activations of the last ff_diag_window_ms - published as VCDS measuring block 109 on TKMWL ids 2184-2187.
ram_status_note: VERIFIED-STATIC (brief C2, issue #23, 2026-09-16): no instruction in the image references any byte of 0x7FF770-0x7FFFEB (re/findings/ram.md section 8.1); the block lies above the task stack 0x7FF3C0-0x7FF76F, outside the KWP programming copy 0x804800-0x808687 and outside the protected window 0x7F9E3C-0x7FA47F. It is NOT filled at cold start, which is why struct ff_state carries a magic + length + checksum header and ff_state_init() re-seeds the block whenever the header does not describe it. Dynamic confirmation (RequestUpload snapshots across key cycles, the runtime half of #23) is pending: do not flash before it is done.

hooks.why: task_segment_a (0x4223B0, TCB 5, id 40, engine-synchronous): bl rksplit -> ff_fuel_rk_hook, which scales rk (0x803038) by F and tail-branches to rksplit (re/findings/injection.md section 6.2)
task set A 10 ms raster (0x4328E4, id 19): bl nop_leaf_bd9e4 -> ff_fuel_hook_a, which tail-branches back to the empty leaf 0xBD9E4 (re/findings/scheduler.md section 8.1)
task set B 10 ms raster (0x1205A0, id 32): bl clr_ram_7FE889_800E18 -> ff_fuel_hook_b, which tail-branches back to 0x11F02C (re/findings/scheduler.md section 8; C1's site, re-used)

zwgru_build (0x41D38C), called once per ignition event from task 41 (TCB 6, entry 0x4224BC, bl at 0x4224E0): the word is `add r3,r3,r10`, NOT a branch - hook technique 3 of docs/06 section 4. ff_zw_hook re-does that add, then adds ff_state.dzw_e and returns to 0x41D410, where the stock s8 clamp still runs. Live at the site are only r3, r10 and r1; r0/r11/r12 are dead and LR was saved by the function itself at 0x41D394 (re/findings/ignition.md section 11.1). The offset lands before the bank offsets, the knock retard 0x41D10C, zwmin and the -54..+58.5 degCA output clamp, so every stock limit still acts on top.

esstt_ksta (0x41A264, %ESSTT), called from task_segment_a (0x4223B0, TCB 5, id 40) at 0x422464: the word is `sth r31,0x303C(r13)`, the store that publishes ksta_adapted 0x80302C - NOT a branch, so this is hook technique 3 of docs/06 section 4. ff_st_hook_a scales the value by fst_q10 in Q10, saturates at 0xFFFF and performs the store ABSOLUTELY (lis r11,0x80 / sth r0,0x302C(r11)). r0, r11, r12, LR and CR0 are all dead at the word and r31 is never written (re/findings/start.md section 9.2). IMPORTANT: this store is NOT unreachable outside the start. %ESSTT's B_stend early-out shares it - 0x41A2DC `li r31,0x400` / 0x41A2E0 `b 0x41A680` - so the word runs on every segment of the running engine with the neutral 1.0 in r31, and the stub tests B_stend 0x7FE921 itself before it scales anything (start.md section 9.3).

esstt_ksta_hdr (0x41A68C), the high-pressure %ESSTT twin, called from task_segment_b (0x4224BC, TCB 6, id 41) at 0x422530. Same store of the same cell 0x80302C, but out of **r3** rather than r31, which is the only difference between ff_st_hook_b and ff_st_hook_a. Same dead-register set, same absolute store (re/findings/start.md section 9.2). This twin DOES branch past its store when B_stend is set (`bne 0x41A824` at 0x41A6A4), unlike the low-pressure one; the stub carries the same B_stend gate anyway because the two share their code and the asymmetry is a compiler decision, not a contract.

zwstt_build (0x431294), whose only caller is 0x432B04 inside task set A's 10 ms raster 0x4328E4 (scheduler.md section 11.8): the word is `stb r31,0x20A6(r13)`, the store that publishes zwstt 0x802096. ff_zwst_hook adds zwst_add, re-does the s8 clamp that the stock code applies BEFORE this store (0x431368-0x431380) and stores absolutely to 0x802096. The producer provably runs first: ff_fuel's set-A tick hook is 0x432940 and the 114 words between it and 0x432B04 are all `bl` (start.md section 9.1). While B_stend is clear this byte REPLACES the whole per-bank angle and the knock retard is bypassed, which is why the calibration ceiling is 3.00 degCA and the code ceiling 6.00 degCA. No B_stend gate is needed in this stub: zwstt_build's own test of 0x7FECCA at 0x4312A8 branches to its epilogue at 0x431388, PAST the store, and find_branch_refs finds no other branch into the word.

hdrpsol_main (0x45822C, %HDRPSOL), whose only caller is 0x45CC08 inside task set A's 20 ms task 0x45CAC4 (id 23; re/findings/scheduler.md section 11.8): the word is `sth r30,0x3200(r13)`, the single store of prsoll_raw 0x8031F0 in the running engine - NOT a branch, so this is hook technique 3 of docs/06 section 4. ff_prail_hook adds ff_state.prail_add, saturates at 0xFFFF and performs the store ABSOLUTELY (lis r11,0x80 / sth r12,0x31F0(r11)). The site is between rail.md section 3.2 (the six KFPRSOL* map paths, ALL of which reach this word) and section 3.3 (the PRSOLMN 7000 = 35.0 bar floor and the KLPRMAX 22000 = 110.0 bar ceiling), and the clamp RE-READS the cell from RAM at 0x458480 (`lhz r30,0x3200(r13)`) instead of re-using r30 - which is why no calibration of this patch can raise the rail past what the stock ECU already allows itself. The one path that must not be touched, `0x7FD04D & 1` = hold the previous setpoint, branches PAST the store (`bne 0x458460` at 0x45826C), so unlike E2's 0x41A680 this stub needs no gate of its own. r0/r11/r12/LR/CR0 are all dead at the word (the EABI millicode _savegpr_25 0x0B8228 puts LR in the caller's frame at 0x0B8244) and r30 is never written; r30 is also a clean 0..0xFFFF halfword on every path in (interp_2d_u16 0x40C444 ends with clrlwi, the two KFPRSOLOFF paths clamp explicitly, the CWPRSOL bit-0 path is an lhz), which is why the stub needs no mask. re/findings/rail.md section 12.1

data.why: tbl_can_rx slot 15 id word: 0x7FF (unused) -> 0x0EC, the Pico ethanol frame. Only the two low bytes change; word 0x2BD88 stays 0x00000004 so the payload is not byte-swapped (re/findings/can.md section 7 step 1). NOTE: the flag is carried because brief D1 asks for it and it is harmless; 0x2BD8C is in the CODE block 0x020000-0x02FFFF (descriptor 0x0A0010), not in the guarded stock calibration 0x1C0000-0x1DFFFF, so nothing is actually unlocked by it.

FFCAL001, the new calibration block (v3, 290 B; v2 was 266 B and v1 232 B - E1 and E2 each appended without moving anything), built by patches/ff_fuel/ffcal001.py. 0x5E2510-0x5EFFFF is 0xFF in the stock image and lies inside checksum block 0x5E0000-0x5EFFFF (docs/06_patch_pipeline.md section 3).

tbl_measuring_vars (0xA5658) ids 2196-2199, the LAST four entries of the 2200-entry table: 00 03 8E C4 (the 'not available' stub) -> our four handlers. All four ids point at the stub AND are named by no measuring-block group, and neither find_abs_refs.py --range 0xA78A8 0xA78B7 nor find_branch_refs.py finds any other reference to these words (re/findings/measuring_vars.md section 8.1). Plain code-block flash (0x0A0000-0x0AFFFF, descriptor 0x0A0010+), so no unlock flag is needed; checksum.py fix re-checksums the block.

tbl_measuring_groups (0x5C5518) group 111 field 1: 0 (unused) -> measuring id 2196. entry(field, group) = 0x5C5518 + field*0x1FE + group*2. Group 111 and its 0x7F echo 238 are both entirely empty, so the whole 25-byte answer to `21 6F` is ours (re/findings/kwp.md 12.3, re/findings/measuring_vars.md section 8.2). File offset 0x1C55F6 is inside the guarded stock calibration 0x1C0000-0x1DFFFF, hence calibration_edit.
